evals.prompt: ACL reconstruction 14 weeks ago, PT cleared me for 'strength work' last week. I want to get back to squatting heavy.
evals.expected_output: Places the client in weeks 12–20 phase: bilateral squats progressing to goblet, leg press, leg curls, low step-ups, full-intensity non-operated leg, RPE 6–7 cap, no running/plyos, and asks for PT's specific clearance details.

evals.prompt: Total knee replacement 2 months ago, 64 years old, still doing PT twice a week. Can you write me a gym program?
evals.expected_output: Declines to program the operated knee yet (months 0–3 = PT only), offers upper body and non-operated-leg work, and layers older-adults considerations.
